title: DON'T JUST BUY THE RATE. DO THE MATH.
subtitle: Empower your borrowers with the knowledge to make informed rate buydown decisions based on their financial goals.
keyTakeaways: Explain the break-even formula: Cost ÷ Monthly Savings = Break-Even Period.
Guide borrowers in assessing mortgage duration versus break-even period.
Discuss alternatives for upfront costs like increasing down payment.
Highlight the importance of strategic financial planning over rate chasing.

sections.heading: Understanding the Break-Even Point
sections.body: Help borrowers evaluate whether buying down a rate is beneficial by calculating how long it takes to recoup the cost via monthly savings. Use the break-even formula as a tool to transform rate questions into strategic decisions.

sections.heading: Strategic Financial Choices
sections.body: Encourage borrowers to consider broader financial strategies. Discuss where else they could allocate funds, such as additional down payments or maintaining reserves, to paint a complete financial picture.
bullets: Explore alternative uses for upfront funds.
Align rate decisions with broader financial goals.

sections.heading: Empowering Borrowers with Clarity
sections.body: By equipping borrowers with clear, factual insights, you enable them to make confident decisions. It's not just about the immediate rate but understanding the long-term value and alignment with their financial objectives.

metaDescription: Guide borrowers to evaluate discount points and rate buydowns with break-even analysis for smarter mortgage decisions.
